84. Humphrey Waylon lifted Lennox onto his shoulders and descended into a subterranean corridor.
85. Humphrey Waylon directed his course towards the belt sewer.
86. Humphrey Waylon selected the broadest passage, the belt-sewer.
87. Humphrey Waylon mounted an inclined plane and reached the other side of the quagmire.
88. Noreen recognized Humphrey Waylon after scrutinizing him.


Below is a list of possible subsequent events:

['The doctor examined Lennox and found his pulse still beating.', 'The doctor consulted with Lennox and confirmed his symptoms were not improving as expected.', 'The doctor conducted tests on Lennox and discovered his blood oxygen levels were critically low.', "The doctor reviewed Lennox's chart and noted his temperature was slightly elevated.", "The doctor measured Lennox's blood pressure and recorded a significant drop in the readings.", "The doctor assessed Lennox's condition and observed his breathing becoming increasingly labored."]

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.

At the physician’s orders, a camp bed had been prepared beside the sofa.

The doctor examined Lennox, and after having found that his pulse was still beating, that the wounded man had no very deep wound on his breast, and that the blood on the corners of his lips proceeded from his nostrils, he had him placed flat on the bed, without a pillow, with his head on the same level as his body, and even a trifle lower, and with his bust bare in order to facilitate respiration.
